# Ling dataset V3.2 data card (generated by generate.py)

## Migration table

Every rewritten call, stub or discovery argument is recorded per conversation in provenance (`migrations`: `migrated_from`, `migrated_to`, `migration_rule`). Counts below are migration records (one conversation can carry several).

| rule | records |
|---|---|
| `discovery_args_remapped` | 2 |
| `merged:air_quality->get_weather(include=[air_quality])` | 3 |
| `merged:archive_email->email_triage(action=archive)` | 2 |
| `merged:get_battery_status->system_status(section=battery)` | 2 |
| `merged:mark_email_read->email_triage(action=mark_read or mark_unread)` | 2 |
| `merged:network_info->system_status(section=network)` | 1 |
| `merged:rain_radar->get_weather(include=[rain_next_hours])` | 4 |
| `merged:set_alarm->set_timer(kind=alarm)` | 11 |
| `retired:astronomy->web_search` | 3 |
| `retired:recipe_lookup->web_search` | 1 |
| `stub_step_removed:tool_already_loaded` | 1 |

Rules defined but unused by this source set (kept for re-runs): every other entry of `MIGRATIONS` in generate.py (merged timers/alarms/stopwatch, bluetooth, wifi, flag, weather alerts, wisp_sync, switch_app, the volume/lock/music -> mac_* skill rules, trash/delete -> `move_path` to `~/.Trash`, grocery evidence -> `search_notes`/`search_reminders`).

Retired tools that appeared only as loaded decoys (preloaded SP schemas or explicit-discovery lists) are mapped to their survivor when merged and removed otherwise (`removed_preload` in provenance); they were never called.

## What changed from V3.1

- Registry: `assets/tools.json` is captured from Wisp source (`capture_assets.py`), not from an eval run: 91 offered built-ins (`update_event` is registered but unavailable, so never offered; `run_applescript` is blocked by the private-shell rule that the always-present identity block triggers), plus `use_skill` and `mac_get_volume`, `mac_set_volume`, `mac_mute`, `mac_lock_screen`, `mac_media` registered by the bundled mac-controls skill (category `skill_tool`, family `skills`, always confirmation-gated).
- System prompt: message 0 is `build_system(loaded)` over loop.SYSTEM's blocks (gating names taken from each block's first line, as Wisp does) + the identity block + the installed-skills catalog (idea-refine, interview-me, mac-controls; a skill's body is appended when its triggers match the user's text). Message 1 is the now line + `CapabilityCatalog.prompt()`. Message 2 is the model-led context note from service/main.py.
- Offer order: loaded real schemas, name-only stubs, then `get_tool_schemas` last (as `model_led_offer` sends them).
- Terse rows (registry.model_schema at terse-tool-schemas c822d511): tools with a SHORT entry get the short line and lose parameter `description` prose at schema positions only (default/enum/const data untouched), except the parameters in KEEP_PARAMETER_PROSE, which keep their full schema; tools without an entry (use_skill, the mac_* skill tools) keep their FULL schema. `get_tool_schemas` and name-only stubs are identical in both styles.
- Every assistant target, tool result and final answer is byte-identical to its source except where a migration rule rewrote it.

## Limitations

- Inherits every V3.1 / V3 limitation (synthetic, template phrasing, condensed tool results).
- `v32_mac_controls` (60 train / 8 dev, ext_v32_mac.py) is the only authored category: explicit and relative volume (read first, about +/-20, clamped), volume reads, mute/unmute, lock success and failure (the answer says NOT locked), Apple Music / Spotify playback, specific-music requests (no call; open_app only after the user accepts), declined confirmations (host text `The user denied this action.`, no retry) and refused arguments (the bad call is context only, the target is the correction). Results are the skill's real output strings; template phrasing is limited (12 train families).
- Merged-tool results keep the old single-purpose shape (e.g. `get_weather(include=[air_quality])` returns only the AQI line).
- The installed-skills block assumes the mac-controls skill ships bundled and enabled and no user skills are installed.
- Quality is unmeasured until Ling is retrained and evaluated (see README gate, including terse-vs-full parity).
